6. A scientist is monitoring the flight of sea birds after they leave their nests on a cliff.
The height above the sea, h metres, of one of the birds is modelled by the equation
\[h=A-Bt^{1.5},\qquad h\ge0,\quad0\le t\le T\]
where t seconds is the time after the bird leaves its nest and A, B and T are positive constants.
Given that
• the bird was 17.6 m above the sea exactly 4 seconds after leaving its nest
• the bird was 11.9 m above the sea exactly 9 seconds after leaving its nest
(a) find a complete equation for the model. (4)
Find, according to the model,
(b) the height of the bird’s nest above the sea, (1)
(c) the limitation on the value of T. (2)

questions.search_text:
8. A student was asked to prove that the square of any number can be expressed in the form 5n or 5n ± 1 where n ∈ ℕ.
The start of the student’s proof is shown in the box below.
Let m = 5k
Consider m² = (5k)² = 25k² = 5 × 5k² = 5n where n = 5k² ✓
Let m = 5k + 1
Consider m² = (5k + 1)²
= 25k² + 10k + 1 = 5(5k² + 2k) + 1 = 5n + 1 where n = 5k² + 2k ✓
Let m = 5k + 2
Consider m² = (5k + 2)²
= 25k² + 10k + 4 = 5(5k² + 2k + 1) − 1 = 5n − 1 where n = 5k² + 2k + 1 ✓
(a) Identify and correct an algebraic error in the box above. (1)
(b) Show the calculations and statements that are required to complete the proof. (4)

answer_candidates.title: Edexcel UK A Level Mathematics 9MA0 June 2025 Paper 1 mark_scheme

9. A racing car is driven along a straight road.
Figure 2 shows a graph of the speed of the car as it travels along the road.
The car starts from rest and is driven for T seconds before stopping.
The speed of the car is modelled by the equation
\[v=15t-te^{0.2t},\qquad0\le t\le T\]
where t seconds is the time after the car starts to move.
According to the model,
(a) find the value of T, giving your answer to one decimal place, (2)
(b) show that the maximum speed of the car occurs when
\[t=5\ln\!\left(\frac{75}{t+5}\right).\] (4)
Using the iteration formula
\[t_{n+1}=5\ln\!\left(\frac{75}{t_n+5}\right)\qquad\text{with }t_1=8\]
(c) (i) find the value of t₃ to 3 decimal places,
(ii) find, by repeated iteration, the time taken for the car to reach maximum speed. (3)
